lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately six vertical columns of high-intensity, circular white clusters are arranged in a semi-regular grid posterior to the gill slits, spanning the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of lighter pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal alignment of high-luminance blobs to create a series of grid-like nodes across the mid-section.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent longitudinal ridges are visible on the upper third of the flank, displaying a sharp vertical gradient with higher luminance on the upper surface and shadow on the lower surface.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Low-density distribution of small, high-luminance blobs scattered primarily on the posterior half of the first dorsal fin's visible silhouette.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A thin horizontal reddish-brown linear marking is visible on the mid-lateral flank, extending posteriorly from the fifth gill slit. Slight irregularities are present on the posterior margin of the pectoral fin.
other_distinctive_markers: High-frequency, small-diameter speckling is visible on the dorsal surface of the head and the leading edge of the primary pectoral fin.
